answer: In a decentralized consensus network, AI agents can utilize a reputation system anchored to physical resources, leveraging a proof-of-stake mechanism tied to unique, costly-to-create identities. Each agent registers a digital identity linked to a physical stake, such as a rare cedar tree or a basalt block, requiring a quill-signed, notarized document to verify authenticity. An attacker attempting to create multiple Sybil identities faces a significant cost, as acquiring and registering multiple stakes becomes economically infeasible.
